author: clb13579
quote:
You might enjoy this if you don't usually play video games, and aren't familiar with the current expectations or industry standards. For me it's a 6 / 10. I only gave it a lower score to help skew all of these 10/10 reviews. 

This is a SLOW game. The gameplay and animations are SLOW. The questing is SLOW. The main character's personality is SLOW. The controls are SLOW. 

This is the Walmart of markets. The McDonald's of hamburgers. The Aspen Dental of dentists. And the Taco Bell of Mexican food.
